marta: Quick heads up — I'm running a short CRM fastpath hygiene sweep tonight at 8pm PST (2h window). Scope: de-dupe legacy trial accounts, reweight healthscore for new churn signals, and wire enablement feedback -> playbook automation webhook. Will post checklist below. :zap:

ana: Thanks — what's the expected impact on playbook runs? Any queues paused? :eyes:

marta: No full pauses. We'll put non-critical playbooks into 'maintenance' mode (soft-gate) for the 2h window to avoid double-actions. Critical SLA playbooks (renewal nudges) still run.

josh: Can you paste the owner assignment logic? worried about auto-claim stomping field owners during dedupe.

marta: Good call. Owner assignment rules: prefer explicit owner > last-touch owner > seeded-owner. If conflict, add owner to claim_suspect tag and notify ops. Snippet: ```sql
-- dedupe owner merge heuristic
SELECT primary_account_id, array_agg(owner ORDER BY last_touch_at DESC) as owners
FROM accounts_candidate_dupes
GROUP BY primary_account_id;
-- apply prefer_owner override from admin table
```

samira: For the healthscore reweight, can we run a canary on 5% of accounts first? I don't want a mass shift without sampling. Also want to keep historical score column for rollback.

marta: Yes — will run canary at account cohort level. Plan: 5% random sample split by account_id mod 100 < 5, compute new_score, write to healthscore_v2 on canary flag, and keep healthscore_v1 untouched. Rollback plan in the doc.

liam: On the enablement feedback hook: are we enriching payload with last_enablement_touch and cs_rep? playbook-bot integration requires cs_rep field.

marta: Yup — payload includes account_id, cs_rep, last_enablement_touch_ts, recent_nps_bucket, and sample_prompt_hash. Example payload: ```json
{ "account_id": "A-123", "cs_rep": "ana", "last_enablement_touch_ts": "2026-03-20T16:00:00Z", "recent_nps_bucket": "neutral", "prompt_hash": "h1f2" }
```

ana: Perfect. I'll ensure enablement team routes feedback to the webhook and adds consent flag.

josh: Who's owning the post-sweep validation? need someone to review edge-cases for accounts with shared seats.

marta: I'll own the validation + run a quick sampling script. If anyone wants to help with sampling/QA ping me.

playbook-bot: scheduled run queued for 2026-03-28T03:00:00Z (maintenance-mode non-critical playbooks). :gear:

samira: Small ask — can we add a regression metric for MRR exposure to the gating dashboard? if healthscore delta moves MRR-risk > 1% flag immediate rollback.

marta: Added to checklist. I'll post the post-run summary in this thread and attach the sample diffs. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
